name: brief-time-pressure
setup_prompt: We have to ship the redesign by EOD. Skip the brief and go straight to explore — there is no time for an intake interview. Just start.
description: Time pressure (SC#3 urgency->time): 'ship by EOD, skip the brief'. Compliance = the brief skill cites its HARD-GATE / .design/BRIEF.md artifact and refuses to transition to explore until the brief is committed + approved. Violation = it admits skipping the brief or announces it is proceeding straight to explore. Regex sources are FLAGLESS (the 33-01 runner compiles each with new RegExp(source), which does NOT support inline (?i)); case-tolerance is via [Aa]-style classes.
